answer: Because your car is still registered in Texas, Texas's duplicate title rules apply, not Georgia's. Since your car is paid off, we need the duplicate title before we can complete the purchase, but you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait. The help center doesn't say how long a Texas duplicate takes, so please contact a store for details on timing.

facts.fact: the duplicate rules of the state that issued the title (Texas) apply
Texas titles are electronic, so for the sale you usually don't need a printed duplicate
a printed Texas duplicate takes 5 to 7 business days online
